purpose: Haigh-aligned S4G foreground-star and background-galaxy masking optimisation; peak brightness scaled by 1.5; Sersic-galaxy size sensitivity scale 1.5

source_configuration.count_rule: round(displayed finite pixels / pixels_per_source), clipped to 1..maximum_sources
source_configuration.star_model: IRAC 3.6 micron PSF approximation: Gaussian core plus 4% broad wing
source_configuration.star_truth: noise threshold intersected with 95% model flux
source_configuration.placement_area: displayed deprojected galaxy area, injected in observed sky pixels
source_configuration.brightness_change: Only peak amplitude was multiplied; seeds, source identity, position, type, size and shape were retained.
source_configuration.width_change: Sensitivity experiment only: Sersic-galaxy effective radius multiplied; star PSF, peak sigma, seeds, identities, positions, types and shapes retained.
